Lemon Tree Hotel offers a perfect blend of comfort, cleanliness, and cheerful hospitality. The ambience is bright and welcoming, staying true to the brand’s signature theme of freshness and positivity. Rooms are well-maintained, spacious, and equipped with all essential amenities like comfortable beds, clean bathrooms, and good Wi-Fi.

The staff are polite, professional, and always ready to help — their friendly attitude really enhances the stay experience. The restaurant serves a good variety of dishes, both Indian and continental, with an emphasis on quality and presentation. Breakfast buffets are particularly enjoyable.

The location of most Lemon Tree properties is convenient — close to business hubs or malls — making it a solid choice for both business and leisure travelers.

Pros:

Clean, comfortable rooms

Excellent service and staff behavior

Tasty, well-presented food

Good value for money

Cons:

Slightly limited parking at some locations

Room service can be a bit slow during peak hours

Overall:
A reliable mid-range hotel chain that delivers consistent comfort and quality with a cheerful vibe. Great for short business trips or weekend getaways.
negative_snippets: Worst experience. There was excessive noise from neighboring rooms throughout the night, making it impossible to sleep. The mattress quality was extremely poor and uncomfortable. The hotel feels very old and is in urgent need of major improvements. This property does not meet Lemon Tree standards at all. The food quality was also disappointing, with very limited and below-average options. Overall, not worth the price and highly unsatisfactory.
